title: Implement patch_test_reference()
objective: Implement patch_test_reference(mesh_coords, target_strain) in verify/analytical.py. Given a constant Green-Lagrange strain E (3x3) and mesh coordinates, compute exact nodal displacement field u_I = E_IJ * X_J.
implementation_steps: Implement patch_test_reference(coords: NDArray, strain: NDArray) -> NDArray
For constant strain E, the displacement is u = E @ X for each node (small strain approximation)
For finite strain (Green-Lagrange): u = (sqrt(I + 2E) - I) @ X (exact), or linearized u ≈ E @ X for small E
Choose the appropriate formulation based on design docs
acceptance_criteria: For known constant strain → displacement matches hand calculation
Input validation: strain must be (3,3) symmetric
risks: Small/finite strain formulation choice affects displacement computation — must match design docs convention
